name: Exploring the Big Apple
source:
Join a young couple on their adventure as they move to New York to start a new chapter in their lives. She's starting university to become a journalist, and he's job hunting while supporting her every step of the way. The choices he makes throughout their journey will have consequences you can see play out as the game progresses.

[From F95Zone]
